program.section_heading: Office Skills: PowerPoint and Outlook Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Use the basic features of Microsoft PowerPoint including slide show creation, editing, and a variety of formatting tools.
Create tables, insert graphics, print, and perform file management for Microsoft PowerPoint.
Integrate PowerPoint with other programs including importing, embedding, linking with Word and Excel, and exporting handouts to Word.
Compose, edit, attach, send, reply, and print electronic mail in Microsoft Outlook.
Customize files, folders, and various areas of Outlook for efficient saving and retrieval in Microsoft Outlook.
Create and modify contacts, electronic business cards, distribution lists, and secondary address books in Microsoft Outlook.
Develop and manage appointments, meetings, events, tasks, and shared calendars in Microsoft Outlook.
Identify and apply appropriate problem-solving techniques using the Help, Find, and Rule functions for Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Outlook.

notes: Total of 72 hours taken from the description '(72 hours, non-credit)'; each course printed at 36 hours.
